# Maps and biomes

_Generated from `content/maps`, `content/biomes`, `scripts/match/world.gd`._

Maps are JSON layouts in `content/maps/`. The expedition map in use is the one `World.layout_for_tier` returns: **Skyreach**. Everything on a layout is fixed; each match only rolls which spawn points, lairs and caches are live, plus loot, the Blight and the weather.

| Map | File | Size | Islands | What it's for |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| The Arena | `content/maps/arena.json` | 52 x 52 | 2 | The practice arena. |
| Skyreach | `content/maps/skyreach.json` | 216 x 216 | 17 | Hand-made expedition map. |
| First Flight | `content/maps/tutorial.json` | 80 x 80 | 3 | The tutorial island group. |

## The Arena

The practice arena: one round floor ringed by low ruin walls with four gates, four pillars to slam people into, a raised dais on the north side for high ground, two patches of tall grass, and a small bench islet to the south across a short bridge (where the generator puts spawn points; the arena itself teleports you to the floor). No monsters, chests or breakables are spawned on it.

| The Arena | grove | Meadow | quiet |  |
| Bench | grove | Meadow | quiet |  |

**Getting around:** 1 bridges.



## Skyreach

Hand-made expedition map. Big walkable regions: the Heart in the middle, four large regions around it (Frostkeep N, Stormreach E, Bloomwild S, Ember Quarry W), four calm corner islands and four outer landings. A ring road of wide bridges joins every region to its corners, so most of the map can be walked. Only six bridges and one wind road lead into the Heart: these are the chokepoints. Perches float over the four diagonal gaps; reach them by a one-way pad or an updraft chain and glide back down. Angles are degrees around an island's centre (0 = east, 90 = south); 'sheer' arcs can't be grabbed, every other rim has a stone lip. Exits: skiff docks on the four landings, walled uplink outposts on three corner islands, rift hatches scattered over the regions. Three boss lairs (walled arenas sealed by a gate) sit on the Quarry, Stormreach and Bloomwild. Generated by tools/make_skyreach.py.

## First Flight

The tutorial island group: a flat starter meadow, a low rise across a wide bridge (one clean step up, for climbing), and the gate isle you glide or walk to, with a small walled outpost whose uplink is the way home. No rocks, no hazards, nothing random.

### Islands

| Island | Role | Biome | Danger | Named spots |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Lookout Rise | grove | Meadow | quiet |  |
| Starter Meadow | grove | Meadow | quiet |  |
| Gate Isle | grove | Meadow | quiet |  |

**Exits:** 1 uplink outposts.

**Getting around:** 2 bridges, 1 updrafts, 1 wind roads.



## Biomes

Each region has a biome (`content/biomes/`): its colours, its monsters and its hazards.

| Biome | Id | In short | Monsters | Hazards |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bloomwild | `bloom` | Overgrown and poisonous: spore pods burst when you get close, toxic monsters leave clouds. | Thorn Skitter, Spore Spitter, Bloom Puffbomb, Moss Brute | spore pod |
| Emberfall | `ember` | Lava vents erupt on a warning glow; molten monsters leave burning ground. | Cinder Skitter, Ash Spitter, Ember Puffbomb, Magma Brute | lava vent |
| Frostreach | `frost` | Ice underfoot and frozen monsters: hits slow you, and they shatter when they die. | Frost Skitter, Rime Spitter, Ice Sentinel, Glacier Brute | ice patch |
| Gloomheart | `gloom` | The void leaks through here: rifts pull you in, void monsters blink, and the loot is the best on the map. | Shade Skitter, Rift Spitter, Void Sentinel, Hollow Brute | void rift |
| Greenreach | `meadow` | Calm meadows. Few monsters, rarely anything nasty. | Meadow Skitter, Spitter, Puffbomb, Brute |  |
| Stormcrest | `storm` | Lightning rods strike marked circles; charged monsters arc their hits to a second target. | Spark Skitter, Volt Sentinel, Static Puffbomb, Thunder Brute | lightning rod |
